name: Formsmith (self-hosted)
free_limit: Self-hosted AGPL-3.0 core: unlimited forms, responses and seats; form builder, logic, scoring, webhooks, API and CSV/JSON exports. No vendor-imposed usage quota.
watch_out: Requires your own Docker/PostgreSQL hosting, TLS, backups and security configuration. AI interviewer needs your own model/API key and may cost money; SMTP is bring-your-own. Enterprise SSO/SCIM/RBAC modules require a commercial license. Early v0.1.0 release; production reliability unverified. AGPL obligations apply to modified network-served software.
